verdict.rationale: A game engine editor could plausibly ship a built-in AI assistant, so this axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Godot ships one. Community MCP servers on GitHub are third-party, and the built-in LSP, editor plugins and EditorScript are developer building blocks, so none of them earn credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
